title: Composition of the Included Mileage Granted on a Car Rental
content:
The included mileage granted on a rental is the rate class's included miles for each booked rental day, placed on the rental in one grant covering the whole rental, and the grant is counted in whole miles.

**The quantities that enter it.** Two quantities make up the grant on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes: the included miles the class publishes for each rental day, and the booked rental days standing on the rental record.

**How they assemble.** The class's included miles for each rental day are multiplied by the booked rental days of the rental. The figure so arrived at is taken as whole miles, and that count of whole miles is placed on the rental as one grant covering the whole hire rather than as a grant for each day. The count to whole miles is taken once, at the end, and at no intermediate step.

**Worked through on hypothetical inputs.** Take a rental, hypothetically, booking 4 rental days on a class publishing 200 included miles for each rental day. 200 miles multiplied by 4 booked rental days gives 800 miles, and 800 whole miles are placed on the rental in one grant. A rental booking 3 rental days on a class publishing 125 included miles for each day carries a single grant of 375 miles.
